requirements.title: MATMUL argument restrictions
requirements.definition: MATRIX_A shall be rank one or rank two and numeric or logical; MATRIX_B shall have the corresponding numeric or logical type, rank one or two, not form a rank-one/rank-one pair with MATRIX_A, and have its first or only dimension size equal to the last or only dimension size of MATRIX_A.

pending.MATMUL-MATRIX_A-rank-one-or-two: Positive source controls call MATMUL with rank-one and rank-two MATRIX_A arrays; source-control mutations use a scalar and rank-three MATRIX_A and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MATMUL-MATRIX_A-numeric-or-logical: Positive source controls use integer, real, complex, and logical MATRIX_A arrays; a source-control mutation uses a character MATRIX_A and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MATMUL-MATRIX_B-type-corresponds-to-MATR: Positive source controls pair numeric with numeric and logical with logical arrays; source-control mutations pair numeric with logical and logical with numeric arrays and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MATMUL-MATRIX_B-rank-one-or-two: Positive source controls call MATMUL with rank-one and rank-two MATRIX_B arrays; source-control mutations use scalar and rank-three MATRIX_B values and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MATMUL-not-both-rank-one: Positive source controls exercise vector-matrix and matrix-vector forms; a source-control mutation uses two rank-one vectors and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MATMUL-inner-dimensions-conform: Positive source controls use 2x3 by 3x2, length-2 by 2x3, and 2x3 by length-3 arguments; source-control mutations alter one extent to break the inner-dimension equality and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MATMUL result type and kind follow intrinsic operator result rules
requirements.definition: For numeric arguments, MATMUL result type and kind are determined as for the * operator; for logical arguments, the result is logical with the kind determined as for the .AND. operator.

pending.MATMUL-numeric-result-type-kind: Use integer and exact real matrices with distinct operand kinds available from guarded SELECTED_*_KIND probes; assert KIND(MATMUL(A,B)) matches the 10.1.9.3 operator result kind and mutate one operand kind so the kind check fails.
pending.MATMUL-logical-result-type-kind: Use logical arrays of default kind and a probed nondefault logical kind; assert the result is assignable to logical variables and KIND(MATMUL(A,B)) matches the .AND. result kind, then mutate one operand kind so the kind check fails.

requirements.title: MATMUL result shape follows the three rank cases
requirements.definition: MATMUL returns shape [n,k] for matrix-matrix arguments, shape [k] for vector-matrix arguments, and shape [n] for matrix-vector arguments.

pending.MATMUL-matrix-matrix-shape: Evaluate MATMUL on integer arrays with shapes [2,3] and [3,4], assert SHAPE(result)==[2,4], and mutate MATRIX_B to shape [3,5] so the shape check fails.
pending.MATMUL-vector-matrix-shape: Evaluate MATMUL on a length-3 integer vector and a [3,4] integer matrix, assert SHAPE(result)==[4], and mutate MATRIX_B to [3,5] so the shape check fails.
pending.MATMUL-matrix-vector-shape: Evaluate MATMUL on a [2,3] integer matrix and a length-3 integer vector, assert SHAPE(result)==[2], and mutate MATRIX_A to [4,3] so the shape check fails.

requirements.title: MATMUL result values are SUM of products or ANY of conjunctions
requirements.definition: MATMUL elements are SUM of elementwise products for numeric arguments and ANY of elementwise logical conjunctions for logical arguments in each matrix-matrix, vector-matrix, and matrix-vector rank case.

pending.MATMUL-matrix-matrix-numeric-values: Use small integer matrices with mixed positive, zero, and negative entries; assert every element equals an independently written SUM of products for the corresponding row and column, and mutate the row/column pairing so at least one element fails.
pending.MATMUL-matrix-matrix-logical-values: Use logical matrices whose rows and columns distinguish ANY(.AND.) from ALL, OR, and positional pairing; assert every result element exactly and mutate .AND. to .OR. in the oracle-control expression so the check fails.
pending.MATMUL-vector-matrix-numeric-values: Use an integer vector and matrix with a zero entry and a negative entry; assert each result element equals an independently written SUM of products and mutate the vector order so the check fails.
pending.MATMUL-vector-matrix-logical-values: Use a logical vector and matrix with one true conjunction per selected column plus an all-false column; assert exact logical results and mutate ANY to ALL so the all-false or single-true column check fails.
pending.MATMUL-matrix-vector-numeric-values: Use an integer matrix and vector with signs chosen so rows produce distinct results; assert each result element equals an independently written SUM of products and mutate the vector order so the check fails.
pending.MATMUL-matrix-vector-logical-values: Use a logical matrix and vector with rows covering true, false, and single-match cases; assert exact logical results and mutate .AND. to .OR. so at least one row fails.
